# Broken links

A link to [a page that does not exist](nowhere.md), and one to
[a heading that does not exist](glossary.md#no-such-heading).

A link to [a real heading](glossary.md#zebra) resolves, and so does
[a real page](includes-draft.md).

## Present heading

Linked as [this](#present-heading), which resolves within the same page.
